item.title: fix(ci): extend runner-backend breaker to PR-gating standalone workflows
item.summary: fix(ci): extend runner-backend breaker to PR-gating standalone workflows OpenGrep precise/full, sandbox-common-smoke, and plugin-init scaffold validation were still pinned to Blacksmith runners outside ci.yml, so PR checks starved during the Blacksmith outage even with OPENCLAW_CI_RUNNER_BACKEND=github. Route them through the same breaker expression and bound sandbox-common-smoke with a timeout.
